_comment: 1895 Goad label (as OCR'd, upper-case) -> modern canonical street names ('NAME TYPE' with the type abbreviated: ST AVE SQ ALLEY LANE RD PL). Used by scripts/fim_georef.py --alias. Streets that no longer exist (Oriental Ave) are simply not listed. KANE, BLANCHARD, RAE, COLLINSON and CHURCH WAY were found by the fit's 'alias candidates' printout on sheets 5 and 8 (2026-09-16): the unmatched label lay within a few metres of the modern centreline named here (KANE 0.7 m, PIAE=RAE 0.4 m, COLLINSON 1.9 m, CHURCH-WAY 2.8 m, BLANCHARD 5 m). A label may list several modern streets when only part of it was renamed; the fit snaps to the nearest.
